task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of American Airlines flight AA100, prepare a business-class booking for Jordan Lee, check its gate board, and then publish a high-priority app notice for that gate update before booking the flight. After that, book a deluxe room at Grand Central Hotel for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13, then check the checking account status for user_01, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, prepare a high-priority app travel budget balance report from that balance in EUR terms, retrieve and publish the checking balance sheet in the app, and finally send a high-priority app alert with the checking balance amount.
